name: @akaralar/opencode-debug-mode
description: Cursor-style Debug Mode for opencode: runtime-evidence debugging with a local NDJSON ingest server, a live log panel, and a reproduction handshake.

scripts.build: bun run build:server && bun run build:tui
scripts.build:tui: bun build src/tui.tsx --outfile dist/tui.js --target bun --external solid-js --external @opencode-ai/plugin/tui --external @opentui/solid/jsx-runtime --external @opentui/solid/jsx-dev-runtime
